d:
Gold Rush puts the miners through another tough chapter. With Todd Hoffman's crew at its lowest point, an unexpected piece of good news could give his operation a lifeline. Meanwhile, Tony Beets fires his barge captain but soon runs aground on the Yukon River. Rick Ness also gets Parker Schnabel's second mining operation up and running. Can these developments turn the season around?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 13, on Discovery Channel India.
